package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"path"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	PracticeTeacherValidationContextSchemaV1 = "practice-task-teacher-validation-context.v1"
	TeacherValidationExplanationSchemaV1     = "teacher-validation-explanation.v1"
	maximumTeacherValidationIssues           = 5
	maximumTeacherValidationBytes            = 16 << 10
	maximumTeacherValidationIdentityRunes    = 128
	maximumTeacherValidationMessageRunes     = 1000
	maximumTeacherValidationHintRunes        = 500
	maximumTeacherValidationFileRunes        = 512
	maximumTeacherValidationLocation         = 1_000_000
)

var practiceValidationDigestPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
var practiceValidationAbsolutePathPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(^|[[:space:]"'(:=])(/[[:graph:]]+|[a-z]:[\\/][[:graph:]]+|\\\\[[:graph:]]+|//[[:graph:]]+)`)

type PracticeTeacherValidationContext struct {
	Schema             string                        `json:"schema"`
	Available          bool                          `json:"available"`
	TaskInstanceID     string                        `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID          string                        `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string                        `json:"task_revision_id"`
	LearningActionID   string                        `json:"learning_action_id"`
	SubmissionID       *string                       `json:"submission_id"`
	WorkspaceDigest    *string                       `json:"workspace_digest"`
	UpdatedAt          *time.Time                    `json:"updated_at"`
	Passed             *bool                         `json:"passed"`
	TeacherExplanation *TeacherValidationExplanation `json:"teacher_explanation"`
}

type TeacherValidationExplanation struct {
	Schema         string                   `json:"schema"`
	Passed         bool                     `json:"passed"`
	BlockingIssues []TeacherValidationIssue `json:"blocking_issues"`
	Truncated      bool                     `json:"truncated"`
	SourceDigest   string                   `json:"source_digest"`
}

type TeacherValidationIssue struct {
	Code     string `json:"code"`
	Message  string `json:"message"`
	Hint     string `json:"hint,omitempty"`
	File     string `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Line     int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
	Column   int    `json:"column,omitempty"`
	StageID  string `json:"stage_id,omitempty"`
	Engine   string `json:"engine,omitempty"`
	Severity string `json:"severity,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContext(
	input PracticeTeacherValidationContext,
	practice PracticeTaskContext,
	learningActionID string,
) (PracticeTeacherValidationContext, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	learningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID)
	if input.Schema != PracticeTeacherValidationContextSchemaV1 ||
		input.TaskInstanceID != practice.TaskInstanceID || input.StudentID != practice.StudentID ||
		input.TaskRevisionID != practice.TaskRevisionID || input.LearningActionID != practice.LearningActionID ||
		input.LearningActionID != learningActionID || !canonicalPracticeValidationUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) ||
		!canonicalPracticeValidationUUID(input.StudentID) || !canonicalPracticeValidationUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) ||
		!canonicalPracticeValidationUUID(input.LearningActionID) {
		return PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	hasSubmission := input.SubmissionID != nil || input.WorkspaceDigest != nil || input.UpdatedAt != nil
	if hasSubmission && (input.SubmissionID == nil || input.WorkspaceDigest == nil || input.UpdatedAt == nil) {
		return PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	if hasSubmission {
		*input.SubmissionID = strings.TrimSpace(*input.SubmissionID)
		*input.WorkspaceDigest = strings.TrimSpace(*input.WorkspaceDigest)
		if !canonicalPracticeValidationUUID(*input.SubmissionID) || !practiceValidationDigestPattern.MatchString(*input.WorkspaceDigest) || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
			return PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		updatedAt := input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
		input.UpdatedAt = &updatedAt
	}
	if !input.Available {
		if input.Passed != nil || input.TeacherExplanation != nil {
			return PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		return input, nil
	}
	if !hasSubmission || input.Passed == nil || input.TeacherExplanation == nil {
		return PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	explanation, err := normalizeTeacherValidationExplanation(*input.TeacherExplanation, *input.Passed)
	if err != nil {
		return PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, err
	}
	input.TeacherExplanation = &explanation
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeTeacherValidationExplanation(input TeacherValidationExplanation, passed bool) (TeacherValidationExplanation, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.SourceDigest = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceDigest)
	if input.Schema != TeacherValidationExplanationSchemaV1 || input.Passed != passed || input.BlockingIssues == nil ||
		len(input.BlockingIssues) > maximumTeacherValidationIssues || !practiceValidationDigestPattern.MatchString(input.SourceDigest) ||
		input.Passed && (len(input.BlockingIssues) != 0 || input.Truncated) {
		return TeacherValidationExplanation{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	seen := make(map[TeacherValidationIssue]struct{}, len(input.BlockingIssues))
	for _, issue := range input.BlockingIssues {
		if _, duplicate := seen[issue]; duplicate || !validTeacherValidationIssue(issue) {
			return TeacherValidationExplanation{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		seen[issue] = struct{}{}
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil || len(payload) > maximumTeacherValidationBytes {
		return TeacherValidationExplanation{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validTeacherValidationIssue(issue TeacherValidationIssue) bool {
	if !validTeacherValidationText(issue.Code, maximumTeacherValidationIdentityRunes, true) ||
		!validTeacherValidationText(issue.Message, maximumTeacherValidationMessageRunes, true) ||
		issue.Hint != "" && !validTeacherValidationText(issue.Hint, maximumTeacherValidationHintRunes, true) ||
		issue.StageID != "" && !validTeacherValidationText(issue.StageID, maximumTeacherValidationIdentityRunes, true) ||
		issue.Engine != "" && !validTeacherValidationText(issue.Engine, maximumTeacherValidationIdentityRunes, true) ||
		practiceValidationAbsolutePathPattern.MatchString(issue.Message) ||
		issue.Hint != "" && practiceValidationAbsolutePathPattern.MatchString(issue.Hint) {
		return false
	}
	if issue.Severity != "" && issue.Severity != "error" && issue.Severity != "fatal" && issue.Severity != "critical" {
		return false
	}
	if issue.File != "" && (!validTeacherValidationText(issue.File, maximumTeacherValidationFileRunes, true) ||
		strings.Contains(issue.File, ":") || strings.HasPrefix(issue.File, "~") || strings.Contains(issue.File, "\\") ||
		path.IsAbs(issue.File) || path.Clean(issue.File) != issue.File || issue.File == "." || strings.HasPrefix(issue.File, "../")) {
		return false
	}
	return validTeacherValidationLocation(issue.Line) && validTeacherValidationLocation(issue.Column)
}

func validTeacherValidationText(value string, maximumRunes int, required bool) bool {
	if !utf8.ValidString(value) || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value || utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > maximumRunes || required && value == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(character) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, character) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validTeacherValidationLocation(value int) bool {
	return value == 0 || value > 0 && value <= maximumTeacherValidationLocation
}

func canonicalPracticeValidationUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}
